stem: Which age group in the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population is currently experiencing an outbreak of infectious syphilis?
explanation: 15 to 29 years is the correct age group. This is the age range identified as currently experiencing the infectious syphilis outbreak in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because this age group is not the one identified as having the current outbreak.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because the outbreak described is not centred on primary school-aged children.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because this is the age group explicitly identified as currently experiencing the infectious syphilis outbreak.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the outbreak is occurring in younger people, not those over 50 years.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the outbreak is described in adolescents and young adults rather than middle-aged adults.

source.hint: The focus is on the adolescent and young adult demographic.
